svg.title: How work moves through skilldrop
svg.desc: Five lifecycle loops, in order. Stage 1, discover, in the product-manager pack: Find the problem worth solving. Start here when a request, a complaint or a strategy question arrives. Gates: G0 where you decide. Ends with a requirement a person ratified. Stage 2, design, in the solution-architect pack: Decide how to build it. Start here when the problem is agreed, but not the approach. Gates: G1 where a review panel decides. Ends with a recorded decision (ADR). Stage 3, build, in the dev-team pack: Build it. Start here when the work is clear enough to write down. Bug fixes start here. Gates: G2 where a script decides, G2.1 where you decide. Ends with merged code. Stage 4, release, in the dev-team pack: Ship it. Start here when a merged change needs to reach users safely. Gates: G3 where a review panel decides, G3.1 where you decide. Ends with a live, reversible rollout. Stage 5, operate, in the sre-oncall pack: Run it. Start here when the service is live, or something just broke. Gates: G4 where you decide. Ends with a postmortem and runbook changes. Outside the lifecycle, ship-a-draft, in the core pack: Wrap any draft. Gates: G5 where a review panel decides. Outside the lifecycle, apply, in the career pack: Apply for a job. Gates: G6 where you decide, G6.1 where you decide. Outside the lifecycle, research, in the research pack: Answer a why question. Gates: G7 where a review panel decides. Outside the lifecycle, comply, in the grc pack: Sign off a risky change. Gates: G8 where a script decides, G8.1 where you decide. Outside the lifecycle, measure, in the data-analytics pack: Trust a dashboard's numbers. Gates: G9 where a review panel decides, G9.1 where you decide. Outside the lifecycle, modernize, in the dev-team pack: Replace legacy code safely. Gates: G10 where a script decides, G10.1 where you decide. Packs for any stage: stakeholder-comms, design, ai-engineering, api-builder, converters, experience-design, trackers, infra-as-code, frontend, skill-engineering.
svg.text: Start at the stage your work is in. Each loop stops at its gold gates, where a script,
a review panel or you decide whether the work moves on.
